# 澳大利亚网球公开赛：印孚瑟斯如何用人工智能改变体育

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/0da2e3c85d01a873f43c9b82fde98b76:52779576edc1bdc975dada3c6bb2f0c1/wimbedon-3.webp)
哈丽特·达特在2025年温布尔登对阵达尔马·加尔菲的比赛现场 | 图片来源：AELTC Jon Super

印孚瑟斯与澳大利亚网球公开赛合作，利用印孚瑟斯 Topaz Fabric 平台，通过受治理的人工智能和以人为本的技术设计，使网球运动更具沉浸感和可及性。

印孚瑟斯与澳大利亚网球协会长达八年的合作，展示了企业级人工智能平台如何通过大规模提供以人为本的创新来改变体育行业。

在2026年澳网赛事中部署的印孚瑟斯 Topaz Fabric 平台，引入了可能重塑观众体验现场体育方式的人工智能应用。

这一演进的核心是 MatchFeel，这是一款由人工智能驱动的无障碍工具，它将实时网球数据转化为触觉感官体验，供盲人和视障观众使用。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/56fa49718eaa135d780c7fc7c91d73fb:5604d81e6ecf39e9a001066272178c10/jessica-pegula-australian-open.png)
杰西卡·佩古拉在2026年澳大利亚网球公开赛中对阵埃琳娜·雷巴金娜 | 图片来源：AO

该系统通过印孚瑟斯 Topaz Fabric 处理实时比赛数据流，并将球的轨迹数据转化为物理输出。
一个磁性环在雕刻的球场模型上追踪移动，而触觉振动则传达速度和方向，并与音频解说同步。
该应用已在2026年澳大利亚网球公开赛上对部分用户进行了试点，展示了人工智能通过多模态数据处理实现体育观赏民主化的潜力。

## 生成式人工智能和人形机器人赋能互动体验

赛事的人工智能整合不仅限于无障碍领域。
Rally，一个驻扎在印孚瑟斯球迷区的人形机器人，利用生成式人工智能提供网球主题的互动体验。
该机器人利用澳大利亚网球公开赛的实时计分数据，驱动包括“发球致胜”预测、自拍模式照片和“询问Rally”聊天（该功能利用了印孚瑟斯获胜预测器）在内的多种功能。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/719333a8390e6b4d8dcdfa5ffc0344e0:42384d85e2aaf1ee24784eeaf521da7d/andrew-groth.jpg)
印孚瑟斯亚太区执行副总裁安德鲁·格罗斯

印孚瑟斯亚太区执行副总裁安德鲁·格罗斯表示：“我们与澳大利亚网球协会的合作持续为人工智能如何提升体育水平树立了全球标杆。
“体育应该属于每个人。在2026年澳网，我们正将负责任的人工智能与以人为本的设计相结合，为人们创造感受、理解和享受网球的新方式。
“从为视障球迷提供的触觉球场，到为球迷打造的人工智能吉祥物，印孚瑟斯 Topaz 正在让体验更具可及性、洞察力和沉浸感。
“这些创新展示了负责任的人工智能在解锁新机遇、驱动更强成果和加速数字化转型方面更广泛的潜力。”

## 人工智能简化战术分析

“比赛关键点”代表了印孚瑟斯人工智能基础设施的另一个应用。
该工具在每场比赛前为每位球员生成三条简洁、由人工智能驱动的洞察，处理的数据集包括排名、历史对战记录、获胜概率模型和球员表现模式。

该系统将复杂的统计输入提炼成围绕发球主导力、相持策略或关键分表现指标等易于理解的叙述，使观众无需专业知识也能理解战术要素。

澳大利亚网球协会首席执行官兼澳大利亚网球公开赛赛事总监克雷格·泰利表示：“印孚瑟斯持续通过丰富体验的技术帮助我们提升澳大利亚网球公开赛的水平。
“在2026年澳网，新的无障碍举措和人工智能能力展示了数字创新如何使赛事更具包容性、信息性和吸引力。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/626d61287a67be01c6a16717c122cf6b:01e0657fc8cf809ab15ab6509222ac5c/craig-tiley-exec.png)
澳大利亚网球协会首席执行官兼澳大利亚网球公开赛赛事总监克雷格·泰利

“技术是一种放大器，它能放大情感、故事，并带来连接感。
“我们很高兴欢迎那些能帮助更多人感受到自己是这项伟大赛事一部分的创新。”

## 人工智能在体育领域的广泛应用

澳大利亚网球公开赛是职业体育领域更广泛的人工智能整合模式的一部分。
温布尔登网球锦标赛在2025年用人工智能驱动的球踪追踪系统取代了人类司线员，这在该赛事148年的历史上尚属首次。
IBM的人工智能平台也为温布尔登的数字观众提供了“比赛聊天”和“获胜可能性”功能。

全英草地网球俱乐部营销和商业总监乌萨马·阿尔-卡萨布表示：“我们致力于为球迷提供最佳的温布尔登体验，无论他们是通过电视、广播、数字方式还是在场地内与我们互动。”

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/79752f208eb30147f3aa425108db84ae:95cb5ac0e1904ce196e9a030bb3c6d1f/dsc-5809.jpg)
女子橄榄球世界杯决赛，英格兰对阵加拿大。图片来源：Greyscale Photography for Capgemini

在橄榄球领域，凯捷的 TryZone IQ 平台应用生成式人工智能处理实时和历史比赛数据，在女子橄榄球世界杯转播期间生成实时战术摘要。

凯捷英国首席技术与创新官史蒂文·韦伯解释道：“TryZone IQ 是橄榄球历史上的首创。它通过生成式人工智能引擎处理历史和实时比赛数据，如球员动作、团队动态和统计数据，为直播期间的分析师生成简洁、可操作的摘要。”

人工智能的部署现已扩展到篮球、美式橄榄球、西甲、一级方程式赛车和“不可征服”运动会，这表明该技术可以在现场体育环境中扩展，同时保持道德框架并支持数字化转型目标。

# Australian Open: How Infosys Transforms Sports With AI
By [Rithula Nisha Ebrahim](https://aimagazine.com/author/rithula-nisha-ebrahim)
January 30, 2026
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/0da2e3c85d01a873f43c9b82fde98b76:52779576edc1bdc975dada3c6bb2f0c1/wimbedon-3.webp)
Harriet Dart in action against Dalma Galfi at Wimbledon 2025 \| Credit: AELTC Jon Super
Infosys and the Australian Open use Infosys Topaz Fabric to make tennis immersive and accessible through governed AI and human-centred technology design
The collaboration between [Infosys](https://aimagazine.com/articles/infosys-and-roland-garros-partner-to-provide-ai-experiences) and Tennis Australia, which stretches back eight years, demonstrates how [enterprise AI platforms can transform sports](https://aimagazine.com/ai-strategy/tacticai-google-deepmind-pioneer-a-sports-led-ai-assistant) by delivering human-centred innovation at scale.
The deployment of Infosys Topaz Fabric at the 2026 tournament introduces [AI applications that could reshape how audiences experience live sport](https://aimagazine.com/articles/the-148-year-tradition-wimbledon-is-breaking-with-technology).
Central to this evolution is MatchFeel, an AI-powered accessibility tool that translates real-time tennis data into tactile sensory experiences for blind and visually impaired spectators.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/56fa49718eaa135d780c7fc7c91d73fb:5604d81e6ecf39e9a001066272178c10/jessica-pegula-australian-open.png)
Jessica Pegula playing Elena Rybakina at the 2026 Australian Open \| Credit: AO
The system processes live match feeds through Infosys Topaz Fabric and converts ball trajectory data into physical outputs.
A magnetic ring tracks movement across an engraved court model while haptic vibrations communicate speed and direction, synchronised with audio commentary.
The application has been piloted with selected users at the 2026 Australian Open, illustrating AI's potential to democratise sports access through multimodal data processing.
## Gen AI and humanoids powers interactive experiences
The tournament's AI integration extends beyond accessibility.
Rally, a humanoid robot stationed in the Infosys Fan Zone, leverages generative AI to deliver tennis-specific interactions.
The robot draws from live Australian Open scoring data to power features including Serve Me a Fortune predictions, selfie mode photos and Ask Rally chats, which utilises the Infosys Win Predictor.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/719333a8390e6b4d8dcdfa5ffc0344e0:42384d85e2aaf1ee24784eeaf521da7d/andrew-groth.jpg)
Andrew Groth, Executive Vice President for Asia Pacific at Infosys
Andrew Groth, Executive Vice President for Asia Pacific at Infosys, says: "Our partnership with Tennis Australia continues to set a global benchmark for how AI can elevate sport.
"Sports should be for everyone and at AO 2026, we are bringing together responsible AI and human-centred design to create new ways for people to feel, understand and enjoy tennis.
"From a tactile court for visually impaired fans to an AI mascot for fans, Infosys Topaz is making the experience more accessible, insightful and immersive.
"These innovations demonstrate the broader potential of responsible AI to unlock new opportunities, drive stronger outcomes and accelerate digital transformation."
## AI simplifies tactical analysis
Keys to the Match represents another application of Infosys' AI infrastructure.
The tool generates three concise, AI-driven insights per player before each match, processing datasets including rankings, historical head-to-head records, win probability models and player performance patterns.

The system distils complex statistical inputs into accessible narratives around serve dominance, rally strategies or clutch performance metrics, enabling spectators to understand tactical elements without specialist knowledge.
Craig Tiley, CEO of Tennis Australia and Australian Open Tournament Director, says: "Infosys continues to help us elevate the Australian Open through technology that enriches the experience.
"At AO 2026, new accessibility initiatives and AI capabilities show how digital innovation can make the tournament more inclusive, informed and engaging.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/626d61287a67be01c6a16717c122cf6b:01e0657fc8cf809ab15ab6509222ac5c/craig-tiley-exec.png)
Craig Tiley, CEO of Tennis Australia and Australian Open Tournament Director
"Technology is an amplifier that heightens emotions, stories and gives a sense of connection.
"We're excited to welcome innovations that help more people feel part of this great event."
## AI adoption across sport
The Australian Open forms part of a broader pattern of AI integration across professional sports.
Wimbledon replaced human line judges with AI-powered ball-tracking systems in 2025, marking the first deployment of such technology in the tournament's 148-year history.
[IBM's AI platforms also power Wimbledon's](https://aimagazine.com/articles/how-wimbledon-ibms-use-of-ai-is-enhancing-fan-engagement) Match Chat and Likelihood to Win features for digital audiences.
Usama Al-Qassab, Marketing and Commercial Director at the All England Club, says: "We are committed to providing fans with the best possible Wimbledon experience, whether they interact with us through TV, radio, digitally or within the grounds."
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/79752f208eb30147f3aa425108db84ae:95cb5ac0e1904ce196e9a030bb3c6d1f/dsc-5809.jpg)
England v Canada at the Women's Rugby World Cup Final. Credit: Greyscale Photography for Capgemini
In rugby, Capgemini's TryZone IQ platform applies gen AI to process live and historical match data, producing real-time tactical summaries during Women's Rugby World Cup broadcasts.
Steven Webb, Capgemini's UK Chief Technology and Innovation Officer, explains: "TryZone IQ is a first in the history of rugby. It processes historic and live match data like player actions, team dynamics and stats through a Gen AI engine, producing concise, actionable summaries for analysts during live broadcasts."
AI deployments now extend across basketball, American football, LALIGA, Formula 1 and the Invictus Games, suggesting the technology can scale within live sports environments while maintaining ethical frameworks and supporting digital transformation objectives.

title: Inside Tesla's US$20bn CapEx Shift to AI, Robots and Energy | AI Magazine
content:
# 特斯拉向人工智能、机器人与能源领域投入200亿美元资本支出的内幕

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/edf81e8ea8ce1a8871b8e338028fedb6:9f5686b91c98d57331ec22c9b5e9aef0/tesla-gen-3-credit-tesla.webp)
Optimus 第三代机器人将于2026年亮相 | 图片来源：特斯拉

尽管特斯拉2025年第四季度营收下滑，其首席执行官埃隆·马斯克仍在大力投资人工智能芯片与基础设施、人形机器人以及太阳能领域。

尽管特斯拉季度财务连续第二次下滑，年营收降至948亿美元，[首席执行官埃隆·马斯克](https://aimagazine.com/news/elon-musk-on-ai-robotics-wef-davos-2026) 对公司未来仍持乐观态度——同时将公司使命从“可持续的丰裕”改为“惊人的丰裕”。

即使在2025年最后三个月利润下降61%之后，马斯克仍宣布将在[人工智能、相关基础设施和人形机器人](https://technologymagazine.com/news/foxconn-nvidia-and-tesla-to-power-humanoid-robot-revolution)领域投入巨额资本支出。

“我们正在为史诗般的未来进行大规模投资，”他在1月28日与投资者的问答电话会议上表示。

这位世界首富还宣布，将停止在加州工厂生产特斯拉Model S和Model X，为特斯拉最具雄心的产品——人形机器人的生产让路。

马斯克自己的人工智能企业xAI，也预计将获得20亿美元的投资。

他重申了关于机器人技术和[人工智能将带来丰裕未来](https://aimagazine.com/news/studying-musks-ai-utopia-where-money-disappears)的论断，并表示特斯拉在[车辆自动驾驶](https://aimagazine.com/news/extended-impact-report-how-sustainable-is-teslas-business)方面取得了进展，并开始“大规模生产Optimus机器人”。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/DrNcXgoFv20/hqdefault.jpg)

中国的比亚迪最近超越特斯拉，成为全球最大的电动汽车销售商。特斯拉首席财务官Vaibhav Tanjea表示，这家美国汽车制造商预计其利润率将因其向完全基于订阅的完全自动驾驶（FSD）模式转型而受到进一步影响。

## 为人工智能投资太阳能

马斯克雄心勃勃地希望通过能源生产来为人工智能提供动力，他声称“太阳能的机会被低估了”。

他补充道：“我们认为，为电网增加显著容量（比如说为人工智能数据中心供电）的最佳方式，是地球上的太阳能和电池，以及太空中的太阳能。

“这就是为什么我们将致力于实现每年100吉瓦的太阳能电池生产，整合从原材料到成品太阳能板的整个供应链。”

作为这项绿色倡议的一部分，马斯克表示，特斯拉在“对人工智能进行大规模投资”的同时，旨在成为“太阳能电池的重要制造商”。他补充说，这将导致对“电池以及整个电池供应链”的投资增加。

即使该公司在能源领域实现了26.6%的同比增长，且Megapack 3和Megablock即将推出，Vaibhav表示，公司预计“将面临来自低成本竞争加剧的利润率压缩、政策不确定性对市场的影响以及关税成本的压力”。

## 特斯拉Optimus发布

预计将在[人形机器人](https://aimagazine.com/news/siemens-ai-powered-humanoid-robots)领域引起巨大轰动，客户可以期待在未来几个月内看到Optimus 3的亮相。

马斯克表示，Optimus将“令人惊讶”，并且是“一个能力超强的机器人”。

他继续说道：“Optimus将真正成为一个通用机器人，能够通过观察人类行为来学习。

“因此，你可以演示一项任务，或者口头描述一项任务，甚至给它看一段视频，它就能完成那项任务。”

特斯拉的Optimus 3通用人形机器人可以通过观察学习 | 图片来源：特斯拉

## 新工厂正在筹备中

特斯拉将2026年视为资本支出大年，Vaibhav指出，资本支出预计将超过200亿美元。

“我们将为六家工厂投入资金，即精炼厂、磷酸铁锂工厂、[网络出租车](https://aimagazine.com/articles/teslas-cybercab-robotaxi-using-ai-for-autonomous-vehicles)、Semi卡车、一个新的巨型工厂以及Optimus工厂，”他指出。

“除此之外，我们还将投入资金建设我们的人工智能计算基础设施，并继续投资我们现有的工厂以增加产能以及相关的基础设施，我们还将进一步扩大我们的机器人出租车和Optimus车队。”

## 人工智能芯片和晶圆厂成为限制因素

马斯克强调，未来三到四年特斯拉增长的一个可能限制因素是芯片生产。

“完成AI5芯片设计并使其成为一款出色的芯片，可以说是需要完成的最关键的头等大事，这就是为什么我在特斯拉花在这上面的时间比目前任何事情都多，”他说。

展望更远的未来，马斯克透露，AI6——“在AI5基础上的又一次巨大飞跃”——有望在不到12个月后跟进。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/oK0UZEE9GPo/hqdefault.jpg)

马斯克还详细阐述了建设一个整合逻辑、内存和封装的“TeraFab”芯片工厂的必要性，他说：“如果我们不这样做，我们将从根本上受到供应链的限制。”

他补充说，在最坏的地缘政治情况下，影响将是可怕的。

## 中国成为特斯拉最大的竞争对手

在[电动汽车市场](https://evmagazine.com/)上输给中国的比亚迪后，马斯克预见特斯拉在人形机器人市场上面临的最严峻竞争将来自长城之外。

“我确实认为，到目前为止，人形机器人最大的竞争将来自中国，”他说。

“中国在规模化制造方面非常出色。实际上，在人工智能方面也相当不错，”他补充说，那里免费分发的模型“不断变得更好”。

他总结道：“所以，中国非常擅长人工智能，非常擅长制造，绝对将是特斯拉最艰难的竞争对手。”

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/edf81e8ea8ce1a8871b8e338028fedb6:9f5686b91c98d57331ec22c9b5e9aef0/tesla-gen-3-credit-tesla.webp)
Optimus gen 3 to be unveiled in 2026 \| Credit: Tesla
Amid a Q4 2025 revenue dip, Tesla CEO Elon Musk is pushing forward with huge investments in AI chips and infrastructure, humanoid robots and solar energy
Despite Tesla’s quarterly finances suffering a second consecutive decline, with annual revenue slipping to US$94.8bn, [CEO Elon Musk](https://aimagazine.com/news/elon-musk-on-ai-robotics-wef-davos-2026) remains optimistic about the company’s future – while changing its mission from 'Sustainable Abundance' to 'Amazing Abundance'.
Even after Tesla’s profits fell 61% in the last three months of 2025, Musk has announced huge capital expenditure across [AI, related infrastructure and humanoid robots](https://technologymagazine.com/news/foxconn-nvidia-and-tesla-to-power-humanoid-robot-revolution).
"We're making big investments for an epic future," he said during a Q&A call with investors held on 28 January.
Elon Musk, CEO at Tesla
The world’s richest man also announced a halt to production of the Tesla Model S and Model X at the California plant, making way for the production of Tesla’s most ambitious product: humanoid robots.
Musk’s own AI venture, xAI, is also set to receive a US$2bn investment.
Repeating his claims that robotics and [AI will bring forth a future of abundance](https://aimagazine.com/news/studying-musks-ai-utopia-where-money-disappears), he said Tesla was making headway in [vehicle autonomy](https://aimagazine.com/news/extended-impact-report-how-sustainable-is-teslas-business) and beginning to "produce Optimus robots at scale".
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/DrNcXgoFv20/hqdefault.jpg)
China’s BYD recently overtook Tesla as the world's biggest EV seller. The US carmaker expects its margins to be further impacted by its transition to a fully subscription-based model for Full Self-Driving (FSD), according to Vaibhav Tanjea, CFO at Tesla.
## Investments in solar power for AI
In his ambition to tap into energy production to power AI, Musk claimed the “solar opportunity is underestimated”.
He added: “We think the best way to add significant capability to the grid – lets say it is powering AI data centres – is solar and batteries on earth and solar in space.
“That's why we are going to work towards getting 100 gigawatts a year of solar cell production integrating across the entire supply chain from raw materials all the way to finished solar panels.”
Vaibhav Taneja, Chief Financial Officer at Tesla
As part of this green initiative, Musk said Tesla aims to be a “significant manufacturer of solar cells” as it makes “massive investments in AI”. This, he added, would lead to increased investment in “batteries as well as the entire supply chain of batteries”.
Even after the company achieved 26.6% year-on-year growth in the energy sector, with Megapack 3 and Megablock awaiting launch, Vaibhav said the company expects “margin compression from the increased low cost competition, impacts to market from policy uncertainty and the cost of tariffs".
## Tesla Optimus launch
Set to make a big splash in the realm of [humanoid robots](https://aimagazine.com/news/siemens-ai-powered-humanoid-robots), customers can expect the unveiling of Optimus 3 over the next few months.
Musk said Optimus would be "surprising to people" and "an incredibly capable robot”.
He continued: “Optimus really will be a general purpose robot that can learn by observing human behaviour.
“So, you can demonstrate a task or literally verbally describe a task or even show it a video and it will be able to do that task.”
Tesla's Optimus 3 general purpose humanoid robot can learn through observation \| Credit: Tesla
## New factories in the pipeline
Tesla sees 2026 as a year of major capital expenditure, with Vaibhav noting that CapEx is expected to exceed US$20bn.
“We'll be paying for six factories, namely the refinery, LFP factory, [cybercab](https://aimagazine.com/articles/teslas-cybercab-robotaxi-using-ai-for-autonomous-vehicles), Semi, a new mega factory and the Optimus factory,” he notes.
“On top of it, we'll also be spending money for building our AI compute infrastructure and we'll continue investing in our existing factories to build more capacity and also the related infrastructure along with it and we'll also further expand our fleet of robotaxi and Optimus.”
## AI chips and fab labs as limiting factor
Musk highlighted that a possible limiting factor for Tesla’s growth in the next three to four years could be chip production.
“Completing the AI5 chip design and having it be a great chip is arguably the number-one most critical thing to get done, which is why I'm spending more time on that than currently anything else at Tesla,” he said.
Looking even further ahead, Must revealed AI6 – "yet another big leap beyond AI5" – would hopefully follow less than 12 months later.
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/oK0UZEE9GPo/hqdefault.jpg)
Musk also expanded on the need to build a 'TeraFab' chip plant that integrates logic memory and packaging, saying: "If we don't do that, we're just going to be fundamentally limited by supply chain."
He added that, in a worst-case geopolitical situation, the impact would be dire.
## China emerges as Tesla’s biggest competitor
Succumbing to China’s BYD in the [EV market](https://evmagazine.com/), Musk foresees Tesla’s toughest competition in the humanoid market to emerge from beyond the Great Wall.
“I do think that by far the biggest competition for humanoid robots will be from China,” he says.
“China is incredibly good at scaling manufacturing. Actually, quite good at AI," adding that the models being distributed for free there “keep getting better".
Summarising, he said: "So, China's very good at AI, very good at manufacturing and will definitely be the toughest competition for Tesla.”

# 微软的AI工具能为梅赛德斯带来F1的成功吗？

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/65a9d596d20016e65a8f2e282566d2f8:738308b5a6858a275c0f15add8615b9f/mercedes-f1.webp)
梅赛德斯F1车手乔治·拉塞尔（右）和基米·安东内利正在寻求2026年的成功。图片：梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队

微软与梅赛德斯-AMG马石油一级方程式车队将云计算和人工智能置于梅赛德斯技术和运营基础设施的核心。

[微软](https://aimagazine.com/company/microsoft)与梅赛德斯-AMG马石油一级方程式车队的关系超越了赛道本身。

他们多年的合作伙伴关系将云计算和人工智能置于梅赛德斯技术和运营基础设施的核心，涵盖其F1活动的全部范围，包括其位于布莱克利的总部以及赛历上的所有赛道。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/KVgIe6wDY4o/hqdefault.jpg)

这项合作在2026年一级方程式赛季前公布，恰逢这项运动工程规则发生重大变化，在动力单元开发和车队运营中优先考虑可持续性、效率和更高的电气化程度。

梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队领队兼首席执行官托托·沃尔夫表示：“我们的运动是由那些通过创新引领的人驱动的。我们很高兴能与微软合作，微软是世界领先的技术领导者之一，其名字是突破性创新的代名词。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/3c39f3fc66349b912ee4bc889f25861d:b590093e3bbbd5e9244d879002f93065/toto-wolff.png)
梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队领队兼首席执行官托托·沃尔夫（图片来源：梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队）

“这次合作也反映了我们致力于保持在性能和进步前沿的承诺。通过将微软的技术置于我们团队运营的核心，我们将创造更快的洞察力、更智能的协作和新的工作方式，展望F1的下一代。”

## 数据驱动的决策

一级方程式围绕速度、精确度和以几分之一秒衡量的竞争边际构建。因此，它提供了一个技术不断被测试和重新定义的环境。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/5ad146d7b58a5431bdc228851aa03e76:c7b9837d123ce8376f2e9277d799e1de/car-logo-1900x1069.jpg)
梅赛德斯-AMG马石油一级方程式赛车上的微软标志

每辆梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1赛车至少包含400个传感器，每秒产生超过110万个数据点。这些传感器监控从轮胎退化到空气阻力等每一个细节，从而能够就比赛策略和车辆设置进行实时决策。

微软的[企业级云和AI工具](https://aimagazine.com/top10/top-10-cloud-platforms-for-ai)现在将被置于这个广泛的数据生态系统的核心。

微软商业业务首席执行官贾德森·阿尔索夫解释道：“我们与梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队一起，正在利用数据并将其转化为实时情报，为更快的决策、更智能的策略和持续的竞争优势提供动力——无论是在赛道上还是赛道外。”

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/4b51065278d9fb2a45628d7b5ec3e12b:d364dd316e9c689f5038bc8008e46609/judson.jpg)
微软商业业务首席执行官贾德森·阿尔索夫（图片来源：微软）

此次合作的关键是[微软Azure](https://aimagazine.com/news/how-microsoft-azure-will-transform-checkout-com-payments)，这是该公司的云计算平台。通过使用Azure的可扩展基础设施，梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队可以增强其模拟、比赛策略建模和性能分析的能力。

Azure Kubernetes服务（AKS）将使工程师能够根据运营需求扩展计算能力，在比赛周末期间支持敏捷性，并使车队能够遵守财务和环境规则。

## 扩展创新

梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1将此次与微软的协议视为其对数字系统持续投资的延续。微软已经支持该车队更广泛的工程和制造网络。

这种关系超越了Azure，还包括生产力与软件开发平台Microsoft 365和GitHub。这些工具支持布莱克利和布里克斯沃思基地在模拟、设计和团队协作方面的工作流程。

梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队首席商务官理查德·桑德斯补充道：“我们很荣幸欢迎微软加入梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队合作伙伴生态系统。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/9e66aa0e40b54f3ab3ac011ec5c82744:e9662e5592e9768a8da213477c36122e/richard-sanders-mercedes-cco.jpg)
梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队首席商务官理查德·桑德斯

“微软的技术已经在我们作为企业的运营方式中发挥着核心作用，这次合作为我们展望下一个技术发展时代开辟了新的创新机会。我期待看到我们的团队如何合作，在整个组织中解锁新的工作方式。”

## 对性能的追求

一级方程式生动地展示了机器智能、[云计算](https://aimagazine.com/articles/how-aws-cloud-tech-is-helping-philips-transform-healthcare)和人类决策如何协同工作。这项运动将机械性能与数字控制相结合，利用数据为赛道内外的一举一动提供信息。

微软英国和爱尔兰公司副总裁兼首席执行官达伦·哈德曼在LinkedIn上写道：“这是一个绝佳的机会，可以展示微软技术如何能够推动更好的性能、加速创新，并为全球超过8亿的F1车迷放大兴奋感。

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/c915ee8e5c618031911bc28a07004b99:7b96dc469382c4a09eda231a6040f3d2/darren-hardman-ceo-of-microsoft-uk.jpg)
微软英国首席执行官达伦·哈德曼

“微软的云和AI技术将帮助这支总部位于英国的车队保持在这项超高速、数据驱动运动的前沿。”

通过合作，微软和梅赛德斯-AMG马石油F1车队旨在探索数据与赛车智能之间不断发展的关系。目标是将信息转化为可衡量的速度、洞察力和可持续的成果，在这项持续发展是常态的运动中取得突破。

# Can Microsoft's AI Tools Deliver F1 Success for Mercedes?
By [Tom Chapman](https://aimagazine.com/author/tom-chapman)
January 30, 2026
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/65a9d596d20016e65a8f2e282566d2f8:738308b5a6858a275c0f15add8615b9f/mercedes-f1.webp)
Mercedes F1 drivers George Russell (right) and Kimi Antonelli are seeking success in 2026. Picture: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
Microsoft and the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team place cloud computing and AI at the centre of Mercedes' technical and operational infrastructure
The relationship between [Microsoft](https://aimagazine.com/company/microsoft) and the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team goes beyond the racetrack.
Their multi-year partnership places cloud computing and AI at the centre of Mercedes' technical and operational infrastructure, spanning the full scope of its F1’s activities, including its Brackley headquarters and all circuits on the calendar.
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/KVgIe6wDY4o/hqdefault.jpg)
Unveiled ahead of the 2026 Formula One season, the collaboration aligns with major changes to the sport’s engineering regulations, prioritising sustainability, efficiency and increased electrification across power unit development and team operations.
“Our sport is driven by those who lead through innovation," says Toto Wolff, Team Principal and CEO of the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team. "We are delighted to partner with Microsoft, one of the world’s foremost technology leaders, whose name is synonymous with groundbreaking innovation.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/3c39f3fc66349b912ee4bc889f25861d:b590093e3bbbd5e9244d879002f93065/toto-wolff.png)
Toto Wolff, Team Principal and CEO of the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (Credit: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team)
"This partnership also reflects our commitment to staying at the forefront of performance and progress. By putting Microsoft’s technology at the centre of how we operate as a team, we will create faster insights, smarter collaboration and new ways of working as we look ahead to the next generation in F1.”
## Data-led decisions
Formula One is structured around speed, precision and competitive margins measured in fractions of a second. As such, it presents an environment where technology is constantly tested and redefined.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/5ad146d7b58a5431bdc228851aa03e76:c7b9837d123ce8376f2e9277d799e1de/car-logo-1900x1069.jpg)
Microsoft's logo on the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula 1 Car
Each Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 car includes at least 400 sensors that generate more than 1.1 million data points per second. These sensors monitor every detail, from tyre degradation to aerodynamic drag, enabling live decision-making on race strategy and vehicle setup.
Microsoft’s [enterprise-level cloud and AI tools](https://aimagazine.com/top10/top-10-cloud-platforms-for-ai) will now be positioned at the core of this extensive data ecosystem.
Judson Althoff, CEO of Microsoft’s commercial business, explains: "Together with the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, we are harnessing data and turning it into real-time intelligence that powers faster decisions, smarter strategies and sustained competitive advantage – both on and off the track.”
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/4b51065278d9fb2a45628d7b5ec3e12b:d364dd316e9c689f5038bc8008e46609/judson.jpg)
Judson Althoff, CEO of Microsoft's Commercial business. (Credit: Microsoft)
Crucial to the partnership is [Microsoft Azure](https://aimagazine.com/news/how-microsoft-azure-will-transform-checkout-com-payments), the company’s cloud computing platform. By using Azure’s scalable infrastructure, the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team can enhance its capacity for simulation, race strategy modelling and performance analysis.
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) will allow engineers to scale computing power in line with operational needs, supporting agility over the course of race weekends and enabling the team to stick to financial and environmental rules.
## Expanding innovation
Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 sees the agreement with Microsoft as a continuation of its ongoing investment in digital systems. Microsoft already supports the team’s broader engineering and manufacturing network.
The relationship extends beyond Azure to include productivity and software development platforms Microsoft 365 and GitHub. These tools support workflows across simulation, design and team collaboration both at the Brackley and Brixworth sites.
Richard Sanders, Chief Commercial Officer at the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, adds: “It is a privilege to welcome Microsoft into the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team partner ecosystem.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/9e66aa0e40b54f3ab3ac011ec5c82744:e9662e5592e9768a8da213477c36122e/richard-sanders-mercedes-cco.jpg)
Richard Sanders, Chief Commercial Officer of the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
"Microsoft’s technology already plays a central role in how we operate as a business and this partnership opens new opportunities to innovate as we look toward the next era of technological development. I look forward to seeing how our teams collaborate to unlock new ways of working across the organisation.”
## The pursuit of performance
Formula One functions as a live demonstration of how machine intelligence, [cloud computing](https://aimagazine.com/articles/how-aws-cloud-tech-is-helping-philips-transform-healthcare) and human decision-making can work in tandem. The sport blends mechanical performance with digital control, using data to inform every move on and off the track.
Writing on LinkedIn, Darren Hardman, CVP and CEO of Microsoft UK and Ireland, states: “This is a fantastic opportunity to show how Microsoft technologies can drive better performance, accelerate innovation and amplify the excitement for F1’s 800 million-plus fans around the world.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/c915ee8e5c618031911bc28a07004b99:7b96dc469382c4a09eda231a6040f3d2/darren-hardman-ceo-of-microsoft-uk.jpg)
Darren Hardman, CEO of Microsoft UK
"Microsoft’s cloud and AI technologies will help the UK-based team remain at the forefront of this superfast, data-driven sport."
Through their partnership, Microsoft and the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team aim to explore the evolving relationship between data and racing intelligence. The goal is to transform information into measurable speed, insight and sustainable results across a sport where constant development is the norm.
